activity.notes: Representative historical PERSON-SPECIFIC milestone point (not a claim of a single year of career). Handel composed the oratorio Messiah in London in 1741. Its first actual performance was in Dublin in 1742 under the Kingdom of Ireland, not London; this Activity describes composition in Great Britain only and does not represent Handel's German-born origin as British birth.

sources.citation_text: Britannica dates composition to 1741 in London and premiere to Dublin 1742.
